description: Creates the scoring rubric an eval's LLM judge uses — 1-10 criteria, each scored on a numeric scale (default 1-5), judged pass/fail (kind pass_fail), or checked in code with no judge (kind check: contains, not_contains, matches a regex, valid_json, max_chars, equals_expected). Write criteria about the FLOW'S JOB (accuracy to source material, tone, refusal behavior), not generic 'quality'.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

check.description: For kind=check: what the code looks for in the final reply.

value.description: Text for contains/not_contains, a regex for matches, a number for max_chars.

description.description: What the judge should look for (max 500 chars).

kind.description: scale (default): judged on scaleMin..scaleMax. pass_fail: judged pass or fail. check: decided in code with no judge — set `check`.

scaleMin.description: Default 1. Ignored for pass_fail and check (always 0..1).

visibility.description: Who can see it: PRIVATE (only the user), WORKSPACE (every member, the default), or SHARED (specific people, granted afterwards). Say 'make it private' → PRIVATE.

name: caliper_rubrics_create
title: Create a Caliper rubric
